details:
The current guidelines states as followed:

Private instances need an invitation or an "in" to enter. This includes Invite and Invite+ instances, Friends and Friends+ instances, and Group and Group+ instances.

On MANY occasions, about 3 times a week, I end up running into world instances where users are on the status color of blue or green which allows for basically ANYONE to join are engaging in behaviors that aren't appropriate, especially for younger audiences and that aren't age gated; Due to this particular section of the community guidelines, this is concerning especially for content creators like streamers.

I've told these people many times that they are risking the potential of a minor or a streamer joining these worlds and end up getting in trouble or even banned from their platform of content, and yet they try to say "well, the guidelines say these worlds are private, so it is allowed" even tho the guidelines state that consent MUST be given, and seeing that behavior in these worlds is, in my eyes, a violation of consent; I myself have even had to pull vods off of twitch due to this.

I believe that this section of the guidelines should be reviewed and changed to be considered as "public" to stop this from happening.
title: Change the community guidelines to consider "Friends+" and "Group+" instances as "public"
